$comment: The Content-Security-Policy of every HTML answer (T-61 part 5). Read by bootstrap/web.py for the server and by tools/dev/csp.mjs for the design gallery. No wildcards anywhere; operators add connect-src origins through QUILTOR_CSP_CONNECT_EXTRA. No provider origin before T-264, which brings the profiles back with them (T-61 part 8a, D-185).
webllmHosts$comment: Measured in T-61 part 7 (report-only, WebLLM 0.2.86, 2026-11-13): model files from huggingface.co, which redirects the shards to its xet CDN us.aws.cdn.hf.co; model libraries (.wasm) from raw.githubusercontent.com.
testHooksOrigin$comment: In connect-src only with QUILTOR_TEST_HOOKS=1: Chromium blocks a fetch outside connect-src before page.route sees it.
designScriptSrcExtra$comment: Design gallery only: the inline preamble of @vitejs/plugin-react.
